problem: Tax is currently a flat rate per storefront. Selling into the EU and US states with destination-based tax means we show the wrong total until checkout, and finance reconciles by hand.
outcome: Every cart line carries a correct, explainable tax amount from the moment a ship-to region is known, and the rules that produced it can be changed without a deploy.

success.text: Cart and checkout totals match for the same confirmed address and rule version
Rule change live in under 5 minutes, no deploy
p95 added latency on cart recompute under 40ms
Every tax line can be explained by a rule id
